Stretcher: inaccessible. Verso: "O'Keeffe" (white paint). Backing: 1. "Petunia & Glass Bottle – 1924 / by Georgia O'Keeffe / Canvas signed / on back of / picture." (Alfred Stieglitz, Label: printed, The Intimate Gallery, black ink) 2. "1928" [written in as year of exhibition on Label: printed, The Intimate Gallery printed label] (Alfred Stieglitz, Label: printed, The Intimate Gallery, black ink) 3. "For Marion Hendrie / Denver Col. / 7th & Washington St" (Alfred Stieglitz, graphite) 
(Source: Lynes, 1999)

cr_data.provenance:
(An American Place, New York, NY); Marion Hendrie, Denver, Colorado, by 1946 
(Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "Infor. from Miss O'Keeffe, 1946. . . . Painted 1925 (thinks 1925, but not sure), sold to Miss Marion Hendrie . . . . Note: Letter written to Miss Hendrie at above address returned –– left no forward address." Abiquiú Notebooks indicates, "Note: In green pickle bottle. Betty Pilkington." (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_post_1999: Lynes publication dates this work 1925. Denver Art Museum dates it 1924. (Source: Information provided for *Access O'Keeffe* by Denver Art Museum, 2025)

credit_line: Gift of the Hendrie sisters in memory of their father, Charles F. Hendrie (1966.44)
description: Velvety purple petunias sit in a shiny green glass bottle. The arrangement sits against a white background that resembles draped fabric or crinkled paper.
title: Petunia
